module.title: FFTPACK 5.1 fast Fourier transforms
entrypoints: test/t*.f drivers calling the {C,R}FFT{1,2,M}{I,F,B}, COSQ, COST, SINQ and SINT triplets in src/
module.expensive_path: the mixed-radix transform kernels (c1f*, r1f*, cmf*, mradf*, mradb*) under the multiple-transform routines cfftmf/rfftmf on long or many vectors
module.rationale: The whole library is one module: one build (make, one static library), one test set, one scientific responsibility. FFTPACK 5.1 (Swarztrauber, NCAR, 2004-2011) computes normalized fast Fourier transforms of real and complex data, sine and cosine transforms and their quarter-wave forms, in 1D, 2D and for multiple sequences, each as an initialize/forward/backward triplet. It is vendored from the NCAR-Classic-Libraries-for-Geophysics container repository as its own codebase because the container holds five unrelated libraries that share no source; this one is packaged alone.
hazards: the eight test drivers draw their vectors from RANDOM_NUMBER after an unseeded RANDOM_SEED(), so a check has to fix its own input
written for single precision; the shipped references are the -fdefault-real-8 build
Fortran 77 argument-type aliasing needs -std=legacy under gfortran >= 10

approval.human_ref: single-module default: the whole codebase is one module; no human decision at STOP 1, the cut is read in the source PR body at STOP 2
